MikMarbleMod 3.21 — install
===========================

This bundle is a complete, ready-to-run UE4SS install with MikMarbleMod.

Requires the UE 5.8 version of Marbles on Stream (Steam build 24556537 or
later). See "Important" at the bottom.

1. Find your game's Win64 folder:
   <Steam>\steamapps\common\Marbles on Stream\MarblesOnStream\Binaries\Win64\

2. Copy the CONTENTS of this zip into that Win64 folder:
     dwmapi.dll   -> lands next to MarblesOnStream-Win64-Shipping.exe
     ue4ss\       -> merges into the existing ue4ss\ folder (if you already have one)

3. Launch the game. UE4SS loads the mod from
     ue4ss\Mods\MikMarbleMod\dlls\main.dll

4. Confirm it worked. In ue4ss\UE4SS.log you should see:
     Using engine version: 5.8
     [MikMarble] Mod initialized (C++ v3.21) -> 127.0.0.1:5000/mod


HTTP API
--------
Two endpoints, both POST, both relative to `path` from config.txt (default /mod).

1) POST {path}/ready — one-shot handshake once the mod is live.

   {"mod": "MikMarbleMod", "version": "3.21"}

   Lets a backend know which build is talking to it. Versions before 3.21 sent
   an empty object {}, so treat both fields as optional.

2) POST {path}/results — sent once per match, when the results are final.

   {
     "type": "race",
     "players": [
       {"name": "Alice", "finished": true,  "eliminations": 2},
       {"name": "Bob",   "finished": false, "eliminations": 0}
     ]
   }

   type          "race" (includes death race), "royale", or "bullseye"
   name          the player's display name
   finished      did they finish / survive
   eliminations  kills credited to that player (0 for environmental deaths,
                 and always 0 in bullseye)

   ORDER IS THE RESULT. Players are listed in placement order: winner FIRST,
   and the LAST entry is the loser. Finishers come first, then DNFs ordered so
   that the first player eliminated ends up last in the list.

   Notes per mode:
     race      finishers in finish order, then DNFs in reverse-elimination order
     royale    winner first, then everyone else in reverse-elimination order.
               If a royale TIMES OUT with marbles still alive, only the winner
               and the eliminated players are reported — the surviving
               mid-table players have no event-derived ranking.
     bullseye  ranked by distance to the target centre; every player reports
               finished: true. The game itself only scores the top three, so
               placements below the podium are a best-effort reconstruction —
               winner and loser are reliable, mid-field is approximate.

   The list can legitimately be EMPTY (e.g. every player is on the ignore list
   below), so handle that rather than assuming at least one entry.


config.txt
----------
On first launch the mod auto-creates:
     ue4ss\Mods\MikMarbleMod\config.txt

with these defaults (which match the bundled dummy server, server/server.py):

  host=127.0.0.1
  port=5000
  path=/mod        # POSTs to /mod/ready and /mod/results

  # Optional: players to leave out of reported results.
  # Comma-separated; the key may be repeated to add more.
  ignore=SomeName, AnotherName
  ignore=ThirdName

`ignore` is off by default. Matching is exact but CASE-INSENSITIVE, and is not
a partial match ("Bob" does not match "Bobby"). It applies to race, death race
and bullseye — but NOT to royale, where placement is derived from elimination
order and removing players would misreport who went out first and last.

On startup the mod prints the list it loaded, and after each match how many it
removed, so a typo is easy to spot:

  [MikMarble] ignore list: 2 name(s) loaded -> somename, anothername
  [MikMarble] ignore list: omitted 1 player(s) from results

To use your own backend, edit config.txt after the first launch and restart.


Important — this bundle ships a custom UE4SS
--------------------------------------------
Marbles on Stream runs on Unreal Engine 5.8, which upstream UE4SS does not
support. This bundle therefore includes a patched build:

  ue4ss\UE4SS.dll
  ue4ss\UE4SS_Signatures\FName_Constructor.lua
  ue4ss\UE4SS_Signatures\GUObjectArray.lua

Do NOT replace these with a stock UE4SS release, and do not delete the
UE4SS_Signatures folder — without them UE4SS fails to start and no mod loads
at all (the log will show "PS scan timed out", "Engine version is not
supported", or it will hang on "Waiting for object construction...").
